description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The Boeing Company is hiring an Associate or Experienced Software Engineer for its Space Intelligence and Weapons Systems Daybreak team. The role develops, integrates, tests, and maintains signal-processing software and production-ready processing pipelines, including new capabilities and modernization of legacy code.
Software Engineer (Associate or Experienced) develops end-to-end sensor signal-processing software, algorithms, integration testing, and numerical validation

Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and maintain end‑to‑end signal‑processing software: ingest raw sensor data, run focusing, motion compensation, calibration, and produce analysis/feature outputs
• Invent and implement new processing capabilities from algorithm prototype to production‑ready code, collaborating with scientists and stakeholders to define requirements and acceptance criteria
• Analyze, read, and refactor legacy C, C++, and Fortran code; create Python wrappers or re‑implement modules natively in Python where it improves readability, testability, or performance
• Build reproducible, containerized processing artifacts (Docker) and package deployments (Helm charts or equivalent) for development, staging, and production
• Author and maintain comprehensive automated tests: unit, regression, integration, and end‑to‑end system tests, including numerical validation against golden datasets and defined tolerances
• Lead system‑level integration and cross‑team end‑to‑end testing with internal and external partners: define test plans, coordinate test events, exercise interfaces (ingest, metadata, telemetry, archive), capture anomalies, and drive remediation to closure
• Define, curate, and maintain representative test datasets, golden outputs, and validation harnesses to support continuous integration and acceptance testing
• Integrate CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, testing (including E2E integration tests) and deployments; gate releases with numerical and interface checks
• Profile and optimize performance  of processing chains; quantify tradeoffs between accuracy and runtime and implement targeted optimizations
• Implement observability and telemetry for batch and service workflows: metrics, logging, and traces that support automatic detection of regressions and rapid incident triage
• Troubleshoot numerical, runtime, and interface failures; perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures and regression tests
• Produce clear developer and operator documentation, reproducible examples, runbooks, and onboarding materials for product teams and external partners
• Mentor teammates on legacy‑code practices, numerical validation, and robust testing patterns; contribute to team culture of quality, reproducibility, and collaboration
• Ensure security and compliance controls are integrated into the delivery pipeline and runtime environments

Requirements:
• This position requires an active U.S. Top Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required) with eligibility for SCI access post-start (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active)
• A final U.S. Top Secret/SCI Security Clearance post-start is required
• An active U.S. Top Secret Security Clearance
• Bachelor's Degree or higher
• 1+ years software development experience
• Professional experience with C, C++, C#, Python, Java, or Ada
• Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status

Preferred:
• 5 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 5+ years of related work experience OR Bachelor's Degree and 9+ years of directly related work experience OR 13+ years of related, relevant experience
• Experience with serverless or container orchestration
• Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools
• Prior exposure to regulated, safety-critical, or aerospace environments
• Understanding of delivery and reliability metrics (DORA or equivalent) and a desire to instrument and improve them
• Experience troubleshooting and incident response mindset for production systems
• Clear communication skills and willingness to support teams and present to stakeholders and customers
• 1+ years' hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent)
• 1+ years' practical experience with containerization
• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code concepts and at least introductory experience with tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK
• Basic experience with CI/CD systems
